description: This file defines a React component 'DeploymentsOverTime' that renders a responsive time-series chart showing deployment counts over time, with controls for selecting different time ranges. It fetches deployment data from an API, processes it, and visualizes it using the 'recharts' library.

methods.name: DeploymentsOverTime
methods.description: React functional component that displays a chart of deployment counts over time with time range filters.

methods.name: toLocalDateString
methods.description: Converts a date input into a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string format.

methods.name: applyTimeRange
methods.description: Filters deployment data based on the selected time range (7d, 30d, 90d, all).
